facts.value: The oldest manuscript in the library is a gospel book, probably written around 860 in Tours. Four full-page illuminations of the evangelists were added at Trier in the tenth century.
facts.quote: The oldest manuscript kept in the Strahov Library contains, as its name suggests, all four gospels. The text was probably written around 860 in Tours (France)
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://strahovskyklaster.cz/en/for-visitors/what-you-can-visit/strahov-library' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'The text was probably written around 860 in Tours'

facts.value: The Theological Hall holds a so-called compilation wheel, a device made for more comfortable study.
facts.quote: In the Theological Hall, you can see a device for more comfortable study, the so-called compilation wheel.

facts.value: After 1950, when Czechoslovakia abolished religious orders, the Strahov Library was incorporated into the newly established National Literature Memorial.
facts.quote: the Strahov Library was incorporated into the newly established National Literature Memorial

facts.value: A star atlas made in Venice in the mid-14th century is among the library's illuminated manuscripts. It was probably in the library of Charles IV.
